D/ CONSTAN TINVS AVG ; R/ SARMATIA DEVICTA

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Sarmatia Devicta issue of 322-325, possibly London mint; if so, RIC vol. 7 no. 290, issue of 323-324; Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bull-necked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing right holding trophy and palm and trampling kneeling figure to right. Reverse inscription:…
